description: Every OS London five-foot (1891-96) spot height and bench mark inside the core box, converted to scene y and assigned to the ground it measures. scripts/build_main_landscape.py draws premises pads from the premises readings, street corridors from the street readings and corrects the marsh between works to the marsh readings; scripts/check_os_ground_levels.mjs compares the drawn ground with every reading. Generated by scripts/prepare_os_ground_levels.py (rules and per-reading decisions there).
source: reference/spot-heights/heights.geojson (layer os-london-five-foot-1893; readers' setting, notes and confidence kept)

category.ground: spot height with setting street, yard, marsh, open_ground, embankment_foot, other or unset (towing path, works ground)
category.mark: bench mark (type bench_mark): the level of the mark, which stands above the ground
category.structure: spot height with setting bridge, building, wall_top, embankment_top or railway

rules.support: T21 left the west strip (x < -628) and the High Street readings where the regional early-marsh support weight is below 0.9 unapplied (T21 decision 1); since T22 the main landscape applies over the whole terrace zone [-1280, -240, -628, 1160] (the core box west of x -628), and elsewhere around each applied reading
rules.street: a street-setting reading within half the street width + 6 m of a drawn street (not a path) sets that street corridor (with the regional street readings)
rules.premises: any other non-marsh ground reading within 1.5 m of a ground-plan site the main landscape pads (centre in the marsh support, outside the terrace zone) sets that pad; inside the terrace zone a yard-setting reading within 1.5 m of a site sets (and creates) its pad
rules.marsh: remaining ground readings (marsh, open ground, bank feet, footpaths, undrawn tracks) correct the marsh between works
rules.terrace: remaining ground readings in the west strip, and High Street readings below the T21 support threshold, inside the terrace zone (open ground, streets the model does not draw, towing paths, yards of sites without a pad) correct the regional terrace ground in the same way

zones.west-strip: x < -628 (the Bromley/Bow terrace west of the Lea and Bow Creek), outside the High Street band
zones.high-street: within 45 m of the Stratford High Street centreline
zones.three-mills: x -628..-300 north of z 620 (Three Mills, Mill Meads, Abbey Lane west)
zones.abbey-mills: x -300..120, z < 340 (Abbey Mills, the pumping station, the Channelsea at Abbey Mills)
zones.channelsea-east: x >= 120 (Abbey Road east, Manor Road, the Woolwich branch)
zones.ltsr-corridor: within 35 m of the LT&SR centreline east of x -640
zones.bromley-gasworks: x -628..-150, z > 620 (the Bromley gas works and the marsh east of it)
zones.abbey-marsh-south: x -150..120, z > 340 (the marsh south of the LT&SR)
